producer_report.summary: Two fixes. (1) Once all of Athena's checks pass, `target/produce` is removed before the gate that runs before the verifier. It is kept when a check fails, because the send-back needs it. (2) The job records a resume mark in `<state>/kept/<job>/resume.json` when its candidate is built, and moves it to stage Verifier once the checks pass. A job stopped for an environment cause, or interrupted with a built candidate, is resumed by `athena retry` followed by `athena go`. The reader still runs. The planner and producer do not. The candidate is rebuilt on the new base. At stage Verifier the checks are skipped and the recorded results are used. The mark is removed on any close except a Failed environment stop, and when it is consumed. The gate thresholds are unchanged. New tests cover cleanup, low-disk resume and interrupt resume, and count planner and producer invocations. CHANGELOG.md has the entry.

checks_run.command: cargo test -p athena-core --locked -- produce_dir_is_removed low_disk_before_the_verifier interrupted_job_with_a_candidate

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows target/produce is absent after checks pass and before the verifier gate, and present when a check fails. Run: cargo test.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo test -p athena-core --locked -- produce_dir_is_removed_after_checks_pass_and_kept_when_a_check_fails`: passes. It runs ask/go for a passing and a failing check, and a free-space probe records whether target/produce exists at each gate. At the pre-verifier gate it is absent when checks pass and present when a check fails (run/mod.rs ~4077).

criteria_check.criterion: A test stops a job on low disk at the gate before the verifier, with enough free space for the first gate and less for the second. It then shows athena retry runs zero planner and zero producer invocations and proceeds to the verifier with the kept candidate. Run: cargo test.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo test -p athena-core --locked -- low_disk_before_the_verifier_resumes_without_planner_or_producer`: passes. low_once_verifying gives plenty of space at the first gate and 3 GB at the second. The first job ends Failed with an environment reason mentioning 'before the verifier'. The retry then shows planner 0, producer unchanged at 1, reader ran again, verifier 1, and the job lands. The verified fingerprint equals the first candidate's, and there is no 'checks' line in the retry.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows an interrupted job with a built candidate resumes the same way: zero planner and producer runs in the retry, and the reader still runs. Run: cargo test.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo test -p athena-core --locked -- interrupted_job_with_a_candidate_resumes_without_planner_or_producer`: passes. A Ui that panics when the checks start (caught with catch_unwind) leaves the job Dispatched and not running. The test then runs athena retry and go. It asserts planner 0 and producer unchanged at 1, reader count rose, verifier 1, the job landed, the verified fingerprint equals the kept candidate's, a 'resume' line was printed, and the mark is spent (run/mod.rs ~4234).

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran fmt --check and clippy -D warnings (both clean), the three new tests and the policy test; I did not run the full suite.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the cleanup of target/produce and the resume-from-candidate retry.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md diff adds an Unreleased entry (about lines 30-42) covering the removal of target/produce after checks pass, keeping it when a check fails, and the resume from the kept candidate with no planner or producer run.

criteria_check.criterion: The resume tests count planner and producer invocations, not free-space function reads (check with Grep in the test code).
criteria_check.evidence: Both resume tests assert on `counts.all()`, a tuple of Planner, Producer, Reader and Verifier counters bumped in the Script wrapper, with the retry asserting planner 0 and producer unchanged. No assertion counts free-space reads. The free-space function only simulates low space or records directory presence.

open_issues: manage.rs is not in the expected deliverables. I changed it by two lines so that `athena close` removes the resume mark of a job the user closed (a mark that stayed would resume a closed job).
A resumed job carries no accepted plan, so the verifier sees no plan section. I did not store the plan in the resume mark.
I ran the new tests, the policy test, fmt and clippy, but not the full `cargo test --locked` suite; Athena runs it.
mistakes: My earlier report did not list the interrupted-job criterion as met. The test was already in place and passes; this report shows it.
learnings: The producer's build directory is `<job_dir>/target/produce`, and `clean_job` removes the whole job directory on every close, so resume state has to live outside it (`<state>/kept/<job>/resume.json`).
An interrupt can be simulated by a Ui whose `line` panics, caught with `catch_unwind`; the job lock is dropped and the job stays Dispatched.
